journey.name: DD-01 Due dates render in human terms and overdue ones stand out
journey.description:
Covers FR-13. RelativeDate resolves an instant against the viewer's own time zone and words it the way a person would: within one day it is named, up to seven days it is counted, beyond that it falls back to an absolute date (core/ui RelativeDate.kt:42-58,79).
The seed rows carry offsets rather than fixed dates so they never go stale: row 1 is due in three days, row 4 was due yesterday, rows 2 and 3 carry no date at all. Both cases are on screen from launch, which is what SeedData.kt:14-16 says they are for.
An overdue date is also coloured with the error colour (TaskRow.kt:112-113). Colour is checked by eye from a screenshot; the wording is checked from the layout dump.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the "Renew domain registration" row shows "Due in 3 days"
Verify that the "Migrate the analytics pipeline to the new warehouse and validate dashboards" row shows "Due yesterday"
Verify that the "Reply to design feedback" row shows no due date text
Verify that the "Book dentist" row shows no due date text
Verify from a screenshot that "Due yesterday" is rendered in a warning or error colour distinct from "Due in 3 days"
